title: Wallet backup encrypts the private key into a keystore before uploading it
intent: Distilled from keystore/backup flows: the private key is wrapped with createCipheriv.update/final, split with Shamir secrets.share and dumped to a V3 keystore (keythereum.dump) before anything is sent. Those derivation and sealing primitives end the key's flow, so only ciphertext and shares leave the process.
